Miraculous Savior.title: Miraculous Saviour
Miraculous Savior.text: (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent's Charge phase (excluding the first battle round), you can select one enemy unit that made a charge move this phase. This unit can make an ingress move and must be set up engaged with that enemy unit. That move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to move.
